dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure data of sweden naturvardsverket download files

description: The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency publishes national green infrastructure data as download files. The folder read holds zip files for the share of area of value cores (2013, and as shapefile in 2016), a cost analysis raster (2013, and as GeoTIFF in 2016) and habitat rasters (2013, and as GeoTIFF in 2016), with sizes from about 100 megabytes to over 1 gigabyte, together with a map layer description PDF and a data description dated 10 January 2013, and a subfolder for grassland data updated in June 2022. Access is a free open download; no licence is stated in the directory listing read. Caveats: most files date from 2013 and 2016, the listing gives no metadata beyond names and dates, and the files are large. Coverage is Sweden. It supports environmental screening and habitat connectivity analysis for roads, railways and power lines, and planning of nature-based solutions; related records are the Swiss BAFU biodiversity geodata and the SYKE open spatial data of Finland.
